text: Three eleven in the morning. The worst storm of the year.
asr: Three eleven in the morning. The worst storm of the year.
caption: Three eleven in the morning. The worst storm of the year.

text: And then my lamp, the lamp I've kept for thirty years, went dark.
asr: And then my lamp, the lamp I've kept for thirty years, went dark.
caption: And then my lamp, the lamp I've kept for thirty years, went dark.

text: Twelve seconds. Just twelve seconds of dark.
asr: Twelve seconds. Just twelve seconds of dark.
caption: Twelve seconds. Just twelve seconds of dark.

text: Then it came back on. All by itself.
asr: Then it came back on. All by itself.
caption: Then it came back on. All by itself.

text: By morning, a boat lay broken on the north rocks.
asr: By morning, a boat lay broken on the north rocks.
caption: By morning, a boat lay broken on the north rocks.

text: Nobody was hurt, thank the tides. But the harbour master was furious.
asr: Nobody was hurt, thank the tides. But the harbour master was furious.
caption: Nobody was hurt, thank the tides. But the harbour master was furious.

text: He said I fell asleep. He said I let the lamp go out.
asr: He said I fell asleep. He said I let the lamp go out.
caption: He said I fell asleep. He said I let the lamp go out.

text: I have three days to prove it wasn't me, or I lose the lighthouse.
asr: I have three days to prove it wasn't me, or I lose the lighthouse.
caption: I have three days to prove it wasn't me, or I lose the lighthouse.

text: Lucky for me, I don't work alone.
asr: Lucky for me, I don't work alone.
caption: Lucky for me, I don't work alone.

text: First stop: the lamp room clock.
asr: First stop: the lamp room clock.
caption: First stop: the lamp room clock.

text: It runs twelve seconds slow. But nobody has touched it in years.
asr: It runs twelve seconds slow. But nobody has touched it in years.
caption: It runs twelve seconds slow. But nobody has touched it in years.

text: Someone moved the pendulum. And look what they left behind.
asr: Someone moved the pendulum. And look what they left behind.
caption: Someone moved the pendulum. And look what they left behind.

text: Wet footprints. Webbed, like a bird's.
asr: Wet footprints. Webbed, like a bird's.
caption: Wet footprints. Webbed, like a bird's.

text: But Pip's foot is tiny next to them, and they're longer than my boot.
asr: But Pip's foot is tiny next to them, and they're longer than my boot.
caption: But Pip's foot is tiny next to them, and they're longer than my boot.

text: No claws. A flat, straight edge at the back. And they come from the sea window.
asr: No claws. A flat, straight edge at the back. And they come from the sea window.
caption: No claws. A flat, straight edge at the back. And they come from the sea window.

text: So who made them? Pause now, and think.
asr: So who made them? Pause now, and think.
caption: So who made them? Pause now, and think.

text: Time's up. Those aren't feet at all. They're swim fins.
asr: Time's up. Those aren't feet at all. They're swim fins.
caption: Time's up. Those aren't feet at all. They're swim fins.

text: Someone climbed up from the sea, in the middle of a storm.
asr: Someone climbed up from the sea, in the middle of a storm.
caption: Someone climbed up from the sea, in the middle of a storm.

text: Someone who didn't want to be seen.
asr: Someone who didn't want to be seen.
caption: Someone who didn't want to be seen.

text: So that night, we kept watch.
asr: So that night, we kept watch.
caption: So that night, we kept watch.

text: Pip took the window. Mabel took a nap. Of course.
asr: Pip took the window. Mabel took a nap. Of course.
caption: Pip took the window. Mabel took a nap. Of course.

text: And Rollo took care of the stake-out sandwiches. All of them.
asr: And Rollo took care of the stake-out sandwiches. All of them.
caption: And Rollo took care of the stake-out sandwiches. All of them.

text: Then, at three twelve exactly...
asr: Then, at three twelve exactly...
caption: Then, at three twelve exactly...

text: It happened again. Right under our noses.
asr: It happened again. Right under our noses.
caption: It happened again. Right under our noses.

text: But this time, I found how.
asr: But this time, I found how.
caption: But this time, I found how.

text: Three cables feed the lamp. One of them was cut clean through.
asr: Three cables feed the lamp. One of them was cut clean through.
caption: Three cables feed the lamp. One of them was cut clean through.

text: The cutter had two ways out: the window, or the stairs.
asr: The cutter had two ways out: the window, or the stairs.
caption: The cutter had two ways out: the window, or the stairs.

text: Look at the window. A spider's web stretches right across it. Not one thread broken.
asr: Look at the window. A spider's web stretches right across it. Not one thread broken.
caption: Look at the window. A spider's web stretches right across it. Not one thread broken.

text: And on the cut cable, a smudge of yellow.
asr: And on the cut cable, a smudge of yellow.
caption: And on the cut cable, a smudge of yellow.

text: Window, or stairs? Which way did the cutter go?
asr: Window, or stairs? Which way did the cutter go?
caption: Window, or stairs? Which way did the cutter go?

text: The stairs! The web says nobody went through that window.
asr: The stairs! The web says nobody went through that window.
caption: The stairs! The web says nobody went through that window.

text: And the yellow? I painted these stairs last week. The paint never quite dried.
asr: And the yellow? I painted these stairs last week. The paint never quite dried.
caption: And the yellow? I painted these stairs last week. The paint never quite dried.

text: Yellow prints. Down the stairs, past the kitchen, all the way
asr: Yellow prints. Down the stairs, past the kitchen, all the way
caption: Yellow prints. Down the stairs, past the kitchen, all the way

text: to the cellar door. A door I have never been able to open.
asr: to the cellar door. A door I have never been able to open.
caption: to the cellar door. A door I have never been able to open.

text: It has a lock with four stones. A net, a moon, a sun, and a wave.
asr: It has a lock with four stones. A net, a moon, a sun, and a wave.
caption: It has a lock with four stones. A net, a moon, a sun, and a wave.

text: Above it, someone carved: tell the shadow's story, first to last.
asr: Above it, someone carved: tell the shadow's story, first to last.
caption: Above it, someone carved: tell the shadow's story, first to last.

text: If you heard our Old Tale, The Man Who Sold His Shadow, you already know this one.
asr: If you heard our Old Tale, The Man Who Sold His Shadow, you already know this one.
caption: If you heard our Old Tale, The Man Who Sold His Shadow, you already know this one.

text: What order opens the door?
asr: What order opens the door?
caption: What order opens the door?

text: The net: forty days of empty nets. The moon: the night the mist woman rose.
asr: The net: forty days of empty nets. The moon: the night the mist woman rose.
caption: The net: forty days of empty nets. The moon: the night the mist woman rose.

text: The sun: noon, and no shadow. The wave: he followed it into the sea.
asr: The sun: noon, and no shadow. The wave: he followed it into the sea.
caption: The sun: noon, and no shadow. The wave: he followed it into the sea.

text: Behind the door, a tunnel. Straight down to the sea.
asr: Behind the door, a tunnel. Straight down to the sea.
caption: Behind the door, a tunnel. Straight down to the sea.

text: In the wet sand, two sets of prints. Swim fins, and boots.
asr: In the wet sand, two sets of prints. Swim fins, and boots.
caption: In the wet sand, two sets of prints. Swim fins, and boots.

text: And on the wall, in my lantern light, I counted our shadows.
asr: And on the wall, in my lantern light, I counted our shadows.
caption: And on the wall, in my lantern light, I counted our shadows.

text: Four of us. Five shadows.
asr: Four of us. Five shadows.
caption: Four of us. Five shadows.

text: The next day at noon, with the sun high and bright,
asr: The next day at noon, with the sun high and bright,
caption: The next day at noon, with the sun high and bright,

text: my lamp went dark again.
asr: my lamp went dark again.
caption: my lamp went dark again.

text: And someone was watching.
asr: And someone was watching.
caption: And someone was watching.

text: The answer is in Chapter One. Comment yours first!
asr: The answer is in Chapter One. Comment yours first!
caption: The answer is in Chapter One. Comment yours first!
